title.zh: 取得的访问模型选择学习经历

claim.zh: 记录只缩小候选：对每类记录与意义，后来记录之后一个形式的候选，是先前候选中在这些记录上成立者。合作命名：对每个转移记录对二词编码成组的词库，命名来源被接纳且支持够每个可及意义命名一次时，命名每个可及原子（每条记录提供可及的候选）之后，可及原子之词的候选恰是其先前候选中可及者，其他词的候选不变；一次访问的局部命名即此律。选择经历后的词库（acquired 51）是分离律的实例：其记录分离两个原子，故每个有限编码序列的解释是其原子的组合。指定初次巡查取得的访问记录和当前绑定歧义选择后续实际接触，产生已有解释接口的输入；旧访问记录的重看修订改变下一选择，实际响应与失败另有见证。
claim.en: Records only narrow: for every type of records and meanings, the candidates of a form after further records are the earlier candidates that stand on those records. Cooperative naming: for every lexicon whose transition record groups the two-word encoding, with the naming source admitted and support for one naming per accessible meaning, after naming every accessible atom, each record offering the accessible alternatives, the candidates of the word of an accessible atom are exactly its earlier candidates that are accessible, and those of every other word are unchanged; a visit’s local naming is this law. The lexicon after selected encounters (acquired 51) is an instance of the separation law: its records separate both atoms, so every finite encoded sequence is interpreted as the assembly of its atoms. Access records acquired through the specified preliminary surveys and current binding ambiguity select subsequent actual encounters, producing the prior interpretation inputs. Reobserving stale access revises the next choice; actual response and failures have separate witnesses.

hypotheses.zh: 给定空间规律、类别、位置目录、首次巡查和以候选缩减为准的首个匹配选择；合作命名只针对实际可取得的原子操作。
hypotheses.en: Spatial law, categories, location catalogue, preliminary itinerary and first-match candidate-reduction choice are supplied; cooperative naming concerns actually accessible atomic operations.

hypotheses.zh: 复用已有取得／构造／分节／绑定历史；成功实例从51单位支持开始，解释计算及记忆维护未分别计价。
hypotheses.en: Reuse the existing acquisition/formation/grouping/binding history. The successful witness starts with 51 support units; interpretation computation and memory maintenance have no separate charges.

hypotheses.zh: 重看干预及场景迁移事件给定；没有推导完整自主校准、选择准则起源或迁移物理代价。
hypotheses.en: Reobservation and rearrangement are supplied interventions; full autonomous calibration, the origin of the choice criterion and physical relocation cost are not derived.

correspondence.zh: 选择只读保留访问、绑定和已尝试位置，不读实际场景真值；命名与移动仍在同一安排中发生。它说明局部探究接续，未识别具体儿童算法或完整互惠沟通。
correspondence.en: Choice reads retained access, bindings and attempted locations rather than actual scene truth; naming and movement occur in the same arrangement. This explains a local inquiry continuation, without identifying a particular child algorithm or complete reciprocal communication.

detail.zh: 选择经历产生旧行动场景构造的解释输入，直接复用其任意序列结论。
detail.en: Selected encounters produce the earlier enacted-scene interpretation inputs, directly reusing its all-sequence conclusion.

output.zh: 旧行动场景下任意编码序列解释与相应原子消息组合一致。
output.en: Every encoded sequence under the prior enacted scene matches the corresponding atomic message assembly.

input.zh: selected_encounters_supply_previous_interpretation_inputs 保证新史的日志、候选、绑定和排除输入相同。
input.en: selected_encounters_supply_previous_interpretation_inputs establishes matching log, repertoire, binding and exclusion inputs in the new history.

conditions.zh: 接口相同不要求支出或完整状态相同；初次巡查及新访问读取成本保留。
conditions.en: Input equality does not identify expenditure or whole states; preliminary survey and fresh-reading costs remain.

detail.zh: 目录不足留下歧义；支持不足阻断动作或输出；错误唯一绑定仍使停止规则停止；原本正确的访问记录可随实际安排改变而过时。
detail.en: An inadequate catalogue leaves ambiguity; limited support blocks action or output; wrong unique bindings still trigger stopping; an originally correct access record can become stale as the arrangement changes.

limitations.zh: 选择准则、初次巡查、重看及合作覆盖仍有给定前提。未证明最优信息／成本、所有注意、沟通意图、情感、意识或演化心理。
limitations.en: Choice criterion, preliminary surveys, reobservation and cooperative coverage remain supplied. No information/cost optimum or complete attention, communicative intention, affect, consciousness or evolutionary psychology is proved.

validation_scope.zh: Lean 4.29.1：22项新定理／46项声明审计，317项继承审计分列；作者反审及两项发展原典比较，无新实验或独立验收。
validation_scope.en: Lean 4.29.1: 22 new theorems / 46 declaration audits, with 317 inherited audits separately rebuilt; author counterreview and two primary developmental comparisons, without a new experiment or independent acceptance.

next_delta.zh: 既有条件连接保留；下一重点是在匹配发育程序中识别已取得访问及所保留来源／次序如何进入实际使用，分别观察当前依赖与旧内容认可。原典已约束自动迁移，但未识别唯一机制或演化史。
next_delta.en: Preserve the completed conditional connections. Next identify how formed access and retained source/order information guide actual use in a matched developmental procedure, distinguishing present reliance from old-content endorsement. Primary evidence constrains automatic transfer without identifying a unique mechanism or evolutionary history.

history.en: 14 October 2026, open-issues plan (study section 117): the claim now states the law first. New core module Becoming.CrossSituational: later records only narrow the candidates (candidates_append); the periphery MachineInstances: cooperative naming narrows exactly the words whose atoms are accessible (naming_narrows, local_naming_narrows), and acquired 51 is an instance of the separation law (acquired_from_separation); the rule choosing the next visit stays the machine’s. Built with scratch_build: core axiom reports empty, the periphery with standard axioms only; the proof binding to MachineInstances still names the earlier run and is repointed at landing. The original theorems and counterexamples are unchanged.

history.en: 16 October 2026, P114, the apart modules read on the shared base (study section 138; Ren, 15 October: “so for our theories, they are proved in a dag order and can be all connected right?”): the main law stated on the shared base, no premise added: the moves of a run read as records: the candidates the first n + k moves leave are exactly those of the first n that stand on the next k (run_candidates_append); a meaning ruled out at a step stays ruled out (run_narrows); a candidate stays one along a run exactly while every later bearing move offers it (run_stays_iff). Becoming.Courses is compiled and audited by the core run (receipt 20261015T172257.067968Z), with empty axiom reports. Claims, hypotheses, Ren's words, dependencies and the earlier proofs are unchanged; only references, bindings, aliases and this entry are added.
